title: ReviewResult
description: A review-result artifact, read for its findings.

engineering.description: The store the review is recorded in (the `--engineering` the command resolved).

findings_block.description: The body carries a `findings` block, an empty `[]` one included: findings.rs:618-633 (`recorded`) answers `Some`; a body with no block (`None`) is `false`.

prose_only.description: Why this review records its findings as prose only, as `--prose-only <reason>` gave it. Present only on a review with no block.

created_at.description: The `at` of the document's first transition (journal.rs:199-201, `Transition.at`; frontmatter.rs:164-171, `transitions`, oldest first).

superseded_by_block.description: Another review-result whose body carries a `findings` block names this one with a `supersedes` edge (planning.rs:7865; story acceptance 5). Pinned by `a_review_without_a_block_superseded_by_a_review_with_a_block_is_exempt_and_listed` and `a_supersedes_edge_from_a_review_without_a_block_does_not_exempt` (aep-cli validate tests).

created_before_opt_in.description: The store sets `findings_required_since` and `created_at` is before the start of that date in UTC; `false` when the key is absent. Pinned by `a_review_without_a_block_created_before_the_opt_in_is_exempt_and_listed` and `a_review_created_at_midnight_utc_of_the_opt_in_date_is_not_exempt` (aep-cli validate tests).

store_requires_findings.description: The project file of the store this review is recorded in sets `findings_required_since` (project.rs:650-702, `RawProjectConfig`, with the change).
